import sys
from collections import deque

INF = 0x7f7f7f7f

def add_edge(u, v, cap, cst):
    global edge_count, head, next_edge, to_node, capacity, cost_edge
    next_edge[edge_count] = head[u]
    to_node[edge_count] = v
    capacity[edge_count] = cap
    cost_edge[edge_count] = cst
    head[u] = edge_count
    edge_count += 1

def spfa():
    global dist, visited, parent, last_edge, flow_amount
    for i in range(len(dist)):
        dist[i] = INF
        visited[i] = False
    q = deque()
    q.append(s)
    visited[s] = True
    dist[s] = 0
    flow_amount[s] = float('inf')
    parent[t] = -1
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        visited[u] = False
        i = head[u]
        while i != 0:
            v = to_node[i]
            if capacity[i] > 0 and dist[v] > dist[u] + cost_edge[i]:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + cost_edge[i]
                parent[v] = u
                last_edge[v] = i
                flow_amount[v] = min(flow_amount[u], capacity[i])
                if not visited[v]:
                    visited[v] = True
                    q.append(v)
            i = next_edge[i]
    return parent[t] != -1

def run_mcmf():
    global max_flow, min_cost
    max_flow = 0
    min_cost = 0
    while spfa():
        current = t
        max_flow += flow_amount[t]
        min_cost += flow_amount[t] * dist[t]
        while current != s:
            capacity[last_edge[current]] -= flow_amount[t]
            capacity[last_edge[current] ^ 1] += flow_amount[t]
            current = parent[current]

def node(layer, node_id):
    return layer * n + node_id

input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n, m, p, c, d = map(int, input[0:5])
index = 5

s = 0
t = n * 99 + 1

max_node = t + 1
edge_count = 1
head = [0] * (max_node + 1)
next_edge = [0] * (20000010)
to_node = [0] * (20000010)
capacity = [0] * (20000010)
cost_edge = [0] * (20000010)

# Read p nodes
for _ in range(p):
    x = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    add_edge(s, node(0, x), 1, 0)
    add_edge(node(0, x), s, 0, 0)

x_list = [0] * (m + 1)
y_list = [0] * (m + 1)

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    x_list[i] = int(input[index])
    y_list[i] = int(input[index + 1])
    index += 2

dist = [0] * (max_node + 1)
parent = [0] * (max_node + 1)
last_edge = [0] * (max_node + 1)
flow_amount = [0] * (max_node + 1)
visited = [False] * (max_node + 1)

max_flow = 0
min_cost = 0

for i in range(0, 100):
    add_edge(node(i, 1), node(i + 1, 1), INF, 0)
    add_edge(node(i + 1, 1), node(i, 1), 0, 0)
    for j in range(2, n + 1):
        add_edge(node(i, j), node(i + 1, j), INF, c)
        add_edge(node(i + 1, j), node(i, j), 0, -c)
    for j in range(1, m + 1):
        for k in range(1, p + 1):
            cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c
            add_edge(node(i, x_list[j]), node(i + 1, y_list[j]), 1, cst)
            add_edge(node(i + 1, y_list[j]), node(i, x_list[j]), 0, -cst)
            add_edge(node(i, y_list[j]), node(i + 1, x_list[j]), 1, cst)
            add_edge(node(i + 1, x_list[j]), node(i, y_list[j]), 0, -cst)

run_mcmf()
print(min_cost)
